title: Qwen3.6-27B hidden long-row liveness dependency localization

protocol.note: Shared-runner sessions deliberately avoid repeated model loads. This is a localization oracle, not final production qualification.

localization.interpretation: Moving attn_out ahead of the established size order introduces a deterministic prefill-root divergence even though declared pairwise intervals pass. Its actual production dependency extends beyond the current recoloring authority or includes a pointer-layout constraint.

decision: Localize attn_out as the first unsafe move. Screen the exact prefix-8/total-duration>=5 order under the ordinary production session before any retention; keep defaults unchanged meanwhile.
